bottleneck.description: Sub-meter optical earth imaging where Satellogic competes directly against Maxar, Airbus, Planet, BlackSky and emerging sovereign constellations - no irreplaceable position.

dependency.key_customers: Strategic US defense/intelligence customer (undisclosed $30M AI contract), Government of Malaysia (via Uzma Berhad), Suhora (India distributor), Albania, various LATAM governments
dependency.key_suppliers: SpaceX (Transporter rideshare launches), in-house NewSat/NextGen satellite bus, in-house optics and AI payload

editorial.notes: Satellogic targets sub-meter optical EO with a low-cost vertically-integrated bus and 'sovereign constellation' technology transfer model (Malaysia, Suhora/India deals). It is a price-competitive challenger, not a sole-source. Same competitive dynamics as PL but with weaker scale and a smaller fleet, so it inherits the LOW rating. Revenue base is small (~$10-30M deals) and customer concentration is high, but that is a financial/scale concern, not a structural bottleneck.
